title: Inspector smoke payload — minimal valid input for the Pro elementor.pro.popup.create tool
_comment: WP-R08 — Inspector smoke (14-fixtures-harness.md §8; 13-tool-catalog.md §1.8; 10-rest-api.md §8.4). elementor.pro.popup.create is MUTATING (class M, side proxied-to-REST: POST elementor-ultra/v1/pro/popup — PHP creates a Modules\Popup\Document and writes the three buckets _elementor_page_settings / _elementor_popup_display_settings / _elementor_conditions; see SUPPLEMENT §A.2). It is a NON-★ Pro tool, so the lean profile registers it DISABLED at boot; the smoke driver must enable it (tools.search 'elementor.pro.popup') before invoking. It CREATES a NEW popup document, so it does not touch any shared disposable draft; the driver trashes the created post_id in teardown. Gated on `requires.pro:true` so a free-only install SKIPS rather than fails (the PHP route returns 501 PRO_REQUIRED otherwise → mapped to an isError, never a -326xx). MINIMAL valid input per §1.8: REQUIRED {title}; status defaults to 'publish'; here we exercise display_settings.triggers with the §A.2 page_load toggle ('yes') + its page_load_delay sub-control (2s) and omit elements/layout_settings/conditions (all optional — omitting conditions defaults the popup to include/general site-wide per WP-R02). The §8 suite asserts no protocol error (-326xx) and a result matching the outputSchema {post_id, edit_url, conditions_stored}.
